function.name: Refactor
function.description: Replaces the definitions of functions this run wrote, and adds helpers they share, to remove duplication. Only call it if something is duplicated.

module.description: The module the function is in, from step 1

name.description: A function this run wrote, to redefine it, or a new helper

signature.description: The type only, without the name or ::. Required for a new helper; empty keeps an existing function's

doc.description: For a new helper, what it does, written into the code as its documentation

definition.description: The complete definition: every equation and any where clause, without the type signature. It must define only this function

imports.description: Complete import lines the definition needs beyond the module's imports
